L15@P0: This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model with both in-person and virtual attendance. Attend this meeting
L16@P0: remotely using Zoom. To request to speak, use the “raise hand” function in Zoom. To join by phone: Dial 1-669-
L17@P0: 254-5252 or 1-833-568-8864 (Toll Free) and enter Meeting ID: 165 657 5431. To provide public comment, Press
L18@P0: *9 and wait to be recognized by the Chair. To submit a written communication for the public record, email
L19@P0: council@berkeleyca.gov.
L20@P0: Live captioned broadcasts of Council meetings are available on B-TV (Channel 33) and via internet video stream.
L21@P0: All Council meetings are recorded.
L22@P0: This meeting will be conducted in accordance with the Brown Act, Government Code Section 54953. Any member
L23@P0: of the public may attend this meeting, however, if you are feeling sick, please do not attend the meeting in person.
L24@P0: The City Council may take action related to any subject listed on the Agenda.
L25@P0: Pursuant to the City Council Rules of Procedure and State Law, the presiding officer may remove, or cause the
L26@P0: removal of, an individual for disrupting the meeting. Prior to removing an individual, the presiding officer shall
L27@P0: warn the individual that their behavior is disrupting the meeting and that their failure to cease their behavior may
L28@P0: result in their removal. The presiding officer may then remove the individual if they do not promptly cease their
L29@P0: disruptive behavior. “Disrupting” means engaging in behavior during a meeting of a legislative body that actually
L30@P0: disrupts, disturbs, impedes, or renders infeasible the orderly conduct of the meeting and includes, but is not
L31@P0: limited to, a failure to comply with reasonable and lawful regulations adopted by a legislative body, or engaging in
L32@P0: behavior that constitutes use of force or a true threat of force.
L33@P0: Government Code Section 84308 (Levine Act) - Parties to a proceeding involving a license, permit, or other
L34@P0: entitlement for use are required to disclose if they made contributions over $500 within the prior 12 months to any
L35@P0: City employee or officer. Parties and participants with a financial interest are prohibited from making more than
L36@P0: $500 in contributions to a decisionmaker for the 12 months after the final decision is rendered on the proceeding.
L37@P0: The above contribution disclosures and restrictions do not apply when the proceeding is competitively bid, or
L38@P0-1: involves a personnel or labor contract. For more information, see Government Code Section 84308.

L24: ## A safe place
L25: 
L26: Our emergency shelter programs offer a safe place to stay with warm meals, for adults experiencing homelessness. It allows residents the safety and support they need to build income and skills while they seek permanent housing.
L27: 
L28: Services include:
L29:   * Clean, warm beds
L30:   * Meals
L31:   * Shower & laundry facilities
L32:   * Access to computers & telephones
L33:   * Access to housing case managers
L34:   * Links to primary mental, dental & medical health
L35:   * Linkages to community & mainstream services
